capabilities: Recommend suitable directories for filing files
Generate tags, titles, descriptions, categories, and dates as metadata
Locate insertion points and continue or optimize text
Create Luhmann cards from files or selected paragraphs
Generate directory indexes with summaries and aggregated tags
extras: Detailed setup guide is in external Configuration Documentation and a video; README suggests enabling content truncation for long documents to control API costs.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in AI help for choosing where to file notes, writing frontmatter metadata, or continuing and inserting content.

requires.name: LLM API key, base URL, and model name

summary: LLM-powered assistant that recommends archive directories, generates metadata, edits and continues text, and creates Luhmann cards.
